The earlier answer still holds. The note about reversing the whole string doesn't work: `"2026-01-02"` reversed is `"20-10-6202"`, not `"02-01-2026"`. Splitting on `-` and reassembling the parts is the correct approach.

```python
def change_date_format(date_str):
    year, month, day = date_str.split("-")
    return f"{day}-{month}-{year}"
```

CONFIDENCE: 97
